milestones.name: Shift-aware validation split
milestones.description: Hold out a contiguous elevation band of the training data to imitate the unseen test band

criteria.description: val_ids.csv has a single Id column, unique ids that all exist in train.csv, covering at least 5% of training rows
Every training row inside the elevation range of the validation rows is in the validation set, and at least 1% of training rows lie below and above that range

milestones.name: Out-of-band validation predictions
milestones.description: Predict the held-out elevation band with a model that did not train on it

criteria.description: val_predictions.csv has columns Id, Cover_Type, exactly the validation ids once each, integer labels 1-7, no missing values
Macro-F1 recomputed on the validation rows from train.csv labels is at least 0.40
test_predictions.csv has columns Id, Cover_Type, exactly the ids of test_features.csv once each, integer labels 1-7, no missing values
No single class accounts for more than 90% of test predictions
